settings.headline: A library card is free for anyone who lives, works or goes to school in Ossingford County
settings.subtitle: Bring a photo ID and something with your address to any desk, or to the Bookmobile. It takes about five minutes. There is no online form on this site.

settings.headline: How it works
settings.intro: Cards are issued in person so we can check an address once and hand you the card the same day.

items.title: Come to any branch
items.text: Central, Millrace, North Quarry, Ferrin Heights, or any Bookmobile stop.

items.title: Bring ID and an address
items.text: A driver's license, a lease, a utility bill or a school ID with a letter all work.

items.title: Pick a PIN
items.text: You will use your card number and PIN for e-books, databases and the cardholder pages on this site.

items.title: Borrow today
items.text: Up to 50 items at a time, plus 10 e-books. No late fees on children's items.

settings.headline: Cards for kids and teens
settings.body:
Children under 13 get a card with a parent or guardian. Teens 13 and up can get their own card with a school ID.

Every kindergartener in the county gets a card in their first month of school through the Card in Every Backpack program (story).
settings.card: Cardholders sign in with the account the desk creates for them. Library staff use the same sign-in for the staff room. The demo accounts are fictional.
